title: Palindromic Substrings
goal: Solve Palindromic Substrings: Expand from each center (odd/even) and count all palindromes; O(n²) time.
strategy: Expand from each center (odd/even) and count all palindromes; O(n²) time.
edgeCases: Count occurrences, not distinct text values; every character is a palindrome, and even palindromes need between-character centers.
